req.title: Emit CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
req.statement: The system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses to enable browser access.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that all responses should include the CORS header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *'. This is crucial for enabling cross-origin requests from browsers. The test suite will verify this behavior across different endpoints and HTTP methods, ensuring compliance with the requirement.

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_on_get
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the '/get' endpoint.
expected: The response should include the 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' header.
The response status code should be 200.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/get')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] == '*'

tests.name: test_cors_header_absent_on_invalid_endpoint
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to a non-existent endpoint '/invalid'.
expected: The response should not include the 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' header.
The response status code should be 404.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/invalid')
assert response.status_code == 404
assert 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' not in response.headers

tests.name: test_cors_header_on_boundary_case_redirect
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the '/redirect/1' endpoint.
expected: The response should include the 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' header.
The response status code should be 302.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect/1')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] == '*'
